newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour plans cabinet minister for employment.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour plans cabinet minister for employment.

text.p: Gordon Brown, finance spokesman for Britain's opposition Labour party, said a Labour government would have a minister of cabinet rank responsible for employment and labour market flexibility.
"We want to begin the reform of the welfare state, to modernise it," he told BBC radio.

"That's why today we will announce...that there is going to be a new minister in the cabinet of employment and labour market flexibility who will be in charge of the new deal for young people and the long-term unemployed, working under David Blunkett."
Blunkett is Labour's spokesman for education and employment.
Brown said a business person would be appointed to chair a taskforce to tackle the problem of youth unemployment, using funds raised from a windfall tax on the profits of privatised utilities.
